title: Literal plus sign in Typst content was interpreted as list markup and changed the cover meaning
symptom: The source intended `+ FIND FRICTION`, but the structurally valid first PDF rendered `1. FIND FRICTION` because the plus sign was parsed as list markup.
expected_behavior: The cover should preserve the literal plus sign and exact intended phrase.
actual_behavior: Format validation passed while visual semantics changed from a plus sign to an ordered-list marker.
proposed_fix: Escape the literal plus sign in Typst content rather than changing the renderer or post-processing the PDF.
fix_attempt: Changed `[+ FIND FRICTION]` to `[\+ FIND FRICTION]`, recompiled the PDF, rendered all eight pages and inspected the resulting contact sheet.
verification: The final contact sheet visibly renders `+ FIND FRICTION`; qpdf still reports no syntax or stream errors.
